notes.title: Demo Livestream
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Scream Fest 2024 is Live![/h1]

Join us for our demo showcase during Steam Scream Fest 2024! 

Watch gameplay, ask questions, and share with us your thoughts. 

We can’t wait to hear from you and discuss your feedback!

notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We’re excited to announce that [b]Cult Of Blood[/b], will be part of the upcoming Steam Scream Fest! 
We took the chance of making more adjustments to our Demo for a better experience.

[list]
[*]Changes on the targeting system. Now when you kill an enemy, if enemies are still around, the 
    target changes automatically to the closest one.

[*]Fixed a bug when skipping the boss battle sometimes would crash/softlock the game.

[*]Balancing adjustments to ammo.

[*]Healing button changed, from right stick button to left bumper ( L1 ).

[*]More graphical updates.

[*]Better optimization overall.
[/list]

As always thanks for your time and we’re excited to see how you all respond! 
Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone and happy Steam Next Fest![/h1]

We’re excited to announce that [b]Cult Of Blood[/b], will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 
We took the chance of making more adjustments to our Demo for a better experience.

[list]
[*]Enemies react when getting hit by range weapons.

[*]Cutscenes can be skipped now.

[*]Graphical updates.

[*]Fixed some minor bugs here and there.

[*]Better optimization overall.

[*]Balancing adjustments to enhance the gameplay.
[/list]

As always thanks for your time and we’re excited to see how you all respond! Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re bringing some news that will enhance your gameplay experience! 
In this update, we’re introducing [b]two difficulty modes[/b] and some [b]balancing changes[/b].

[h1]Normal Mode[/h1]
For new players that are not familiar with tank controls and fixed cameras. Normal Mode is designed to offer a satisfying challenge without being overwhelming.

[h1]Hard Mode[/h1]
For more advanced players that want a challenge. Enemies will be tougher and more aggressive.

In addition to these new difficulty options, we’ve made several balancing adjustments to enhance the overall gameplay experience.

We believe these changes will provide a more engaging experience for every player. We’re excited to see how you all respond! Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming!
